title: Grinding + EDM + Heat Treatment Routing
description: Wire PRISM's grinding pipeline (GrindingProgramAssemblerEngine — 5 types, 6 dialects) and EDM pipeline (EDMProgramAssemblerEngine — 6 dialects) to hyperMILL workflows. Add heat treatment routing so that operations requiring pre/post heat treatment are automatically sequenced. Addresses the gap where grinding/EDM engines exist and are production-ready but have zero connection to hyperMILL workflows.

reference: Agent 6 report (hooks for burn risk, wheel check)

sessions.title: Grinding Pipeline Wiring + Burn Risk Gate
sessions.intent: Wire the production-ready grinding pipeline to hyperMILL workflows so that parts requiring grinding (hardened surfaces, tight tolerances, bearing bores) are automatically routed to grinding with physics-validated parameters. Build burn risk gate.

units.title: Wire GrindingProgramAssemblerEngine to hyperMILL finishing workflow
units.description: Create HyperMillGrindingBridge that routes hyperMILL finishing operations to PRISM's GrindingProgramAssemblerEngine when: (1) surface finish requirement < Ra 0.4, (2) tolerance < 0.01mm, (3) material is hardened > 55 HRC, or (4) feature is bearing bore/journal. Bridge translates hyperMILL operation params to grinding params (wheel spec, dress cycle, infeed, traverse). Create cam:hypermill_grinding_route action.
units.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP
exit_criteria: HyperMillGrindingBridge.ts routes to GrindingProgramAssemblerEngine
4 routing triggers active (Ra, tolerance, hardness, feature type)
cam:hypermill_grinding_route action registered
Grinding params include wheel spec from GrindingEngine's database
A machinist would accept the grinding parameter recommendations
4 unit tests: Ra trigger, tolerance trigger, hardness trigger, bearing bore

units.title: Build hypermill-grinding-burn-risk hook + wheel check validation
units.description: Build hypermill-grinding-burn-risk hook that computes specific grinding energy (u = Ft / (ae * b)) and blocks if exceeding material-specific burn threshold from constants.ts. Add wheel condition check: warn if estimated wheel life remaining < 20%, block if wheel spec incompatible with material (e.g., aluminum oxide wheel on carbide). Agent 6 designed 3 grinding hooks — this implements the most critical ones.
units.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP
exit_criteria: hypermill-grinding-burn-risk hook blocks on burn threshold exceedance
Specific grinding energy formula uses constants.ts values
Wheel compatibility check validates wheel-material pairing
Wheel life warning at < 20% remaining
3 unit tests: safe operation, burn risk block, wheel incompatibility block

units.title: Wire EDMProgramAssemblerEngine to hyperMILL electrode workflow
units.description: Create HyperMillEDMBridge that connects hyperMILL's electrode design (from HyperCADSAutomationEngine/MoldCycleEngine) to PRISM's EDMProgramAssemblerEngine. Route: electrode geometry → EDM type selection (wire/sinker/micro) → spark gap calculation → EDM program generation. Include overcut allowance transfer from mold electrode design.

exit_criteria: HyperMillEDMBridge.ts routes electrode designs to EDMProgramAssemblerEngine
Wire/sinker/micro EDM type auto-selected from electrode geometry
Spark gap parameters from EDMEngine's database
Overcut allowance (rough/finish) transferred from electrode design
cam:hypermill_edm_route action registered
3 unit tests: sinker EDM cavity, wire EDM contour, micro EDM feature

sessions.title: Heat Treatment Routing + Combined Secondary Ops Sequencing

smart_config.role: Manufacturing Process Engineer + Heat Treatment Specialist

sessions.intent: Build heat treatment routing so that hyperMILL operations on materials requiring heat treatment (case hardening, through hardening, stress relief, age hardening) are automatically sequenced with pre/post heat treatment steps. Create combined grinding + EDM + heat treatment secondary operations sequencer.

units.title: Build heat treatment routing from material + hardness requirements
units.description: Create HyperMillHeatTreatmentRouter that examines part material and hardness requirements to insert heat treatment steps: pre-machine anneal (if material is work-hardened), stress relief (after heavy roughing), through harden (before finish grinding), case harden (carburize/nitride before final finish). Uses MaterialRegistry heat treatment specs and material-specific temperature/time/quench data.
units.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP
exit_criteria: HyperMillHeatTreatmentRouter.ts determines required heat treatments from material + hardness
4 heat treatment types supported (anneal, stress relief, through harden, case harden)
Temperature/time/quench parameters from MaterialRegistry (not hardcoded)
cam:hypermill_heat_treat_route action registered
A heat treat shop would accept the temperature/time specifications
4 unit tests: anneal before rough, stress relief after rough, harden before grind, case harden sequence

units.title: Build combined secondary ops sequencer (grinding + EDM + heat treat)
units.description: Create HyperMillSecondaryOpsSequencer that combines grinding, EDM, and heat treatment into a correct manufacturing sequence. Example: rough machine → stress relief → semi-finish → harden → finish grind → EDM features → final inspect. Enforces physical constraints (can't grind before hardening if grinding is for hardened finish, can't EDM before stress relief if EDM causes stress).
units.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP
exit_criteria: HyperMillSecondaryOpsSequencer.ts sequences grinding + EDM + heat treat correctly
Physical constraints enforced (no grind before harden if hardened finish required)
cam:hypermill_secondary_ops_sequence action registered
Complete mold tool sequence validated (rough → stress relieve → harden → grind → EDM)
3 unit tests: mold tool sequence, bearing sequence, gear sequence

units.title: Build material certification traceability for heat-treated parts
units.description: Wire material certification tracking so that heat-treated parts maintain traceability: material cert → heat treat cert → final inspection cert. Each step records material lot, process parameters, and operator/furnace ID. Creates data structure compatible with MS10 quality chain and AS9102 FAI requirements.
units.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP
exit_criteria: Material cert → heat treat cert → inspection cert chain tracked
Each cert records lot, process params, operator/equipment ID
Data structure compatible with FAI AS9102 format
3 unit tests: cert chain creation, cert chain query, AS9102 format export

sessions.exit_gate: ✓ Heat treatment routing active | ✓ Secondary ops sequencer correct | ✓ Material cert traceability chain | ✓ tsc 0 errors | ✓ 10+ tests pass | omega_floor >= 0.90 | SVI delta: +2%
